name: Lihuan
source:
Elegant and poised, queen Lihuan's love for her kingdom is only surpassed by her love for her family. With her two children steadily in their adulthood now, people wonder when she will finally cut those apron strings loose.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=37940]official thread[/url]]
